note: The Admin Corridor's fabric (DR-106), cut from the one Kalamontee layout in scripts/fabric-kalamontee.mjs -- regenerate from there, do not hand-edit. ADMIN-CORRIDOR.metadata.json: 4.4 x 3.4 x 10, the eye at the middle, 5 m from the rift's lip; built from parts (its roof stops 2 m short of the lip, while the south block's roof beside it runs on to the face), so it draws its own ('open'). A sky room (SHARED-ROOM-METADATA).

The game: "rent apart ... You can see the sky through the severed roof above, and the ground is thick with rubble. To the north is a gaping rift, at least eight meters across and thirty meters deep" (compone.zil 1013-1017). North, the lip and the 8 m rift, 31 m deep, open to the sky; across it Admin Corridor North's severed end in the north block's 4.8 m face, its three portals and their signs. With LADDER-FLAG the ladder lies across on both lips. West, 1.5 m south of the eye, the 2.4 x 2.8 doorway labelled "Sistumz Moniturz" onto the Systems Monitors; south, the 3.4 x 2.9 mouth onto Admin Corridor South, the Junction and the Mech corridors beyond it down the one line.
